findings.candidate_quote: Furthermore, fiber supplementation significantly reduced insulin-mediated carbohydrate oxidation (p=0.027) and fat oxidation (p=0.006) compared to the placebo.
findings.reference_quote:
Accordingly,
insulin-mediated suppression of fat oxidation was less pronounced in the fiber group compared to placebo
(p = 0.006).
findings.explanation: The fat-oxidation direction is reversed. Fiber reduced insulin-mediated suppression of fat oxidation, meaning fat oxidation decreased less than with placebo; it did not reduce fat oxidation compared with placebo. The carbohydrate-oxidation comparison is supported. This reversal misstates a central substrate-metabolism result.
